entries.original_title: The CD47-signal regulatory protein alpha (SIRPa) interaction is a therapeutic target for human solid tumors
entries.original_authors: Willingham, Stephen B.; Volkmer, Joerg P.; Gentles, Andrew J.; Sahoo, D.; Dalerba, P.; Mitra, S. S.; Wang, J.; Contreras-Trujillo, H.; Martin, R.; Cohen, J. D.; Lovelace, P.; Scheeren, F. A.; Chao, M. P.; Weissman, Irving L.
entries.description: Anti-CD47 antibody treatment reduces the final tumor weight of syngeneic mouse breast tumors compared with an IgG isotype control.
entries.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 6A–C of Willingham et al. (2012).
entries.notes: The authors explicitly describe this as a direct replication. Anti-CD47-treated tumors were heavier than controls, but the difference was not statistically significant, so this is a failure rather than a reversal.
